context_length: Trained at 512 residues, then 2,048 for the last 500k steps; longer sequences are embedded whole here
summary: The 300M ESM Cambrian encoder: a representation-focused masked PLM that its developers report performs similarly to ESM-2 650M with less memory and faster inference, producing 960-dim embeddings.
architecture: Encoder-only transformer, 30 layers and width 960, with pre-LayerNorm, rotary embeddings, SwiGLU and no biases. Companion to the generative ESM3.
pretraining_data: UniRef plus metagenomic sequences from MGnify and the Joint Genome Institute, clustered at 70% identity (83M, 372M and 2B clusters).
key_innovations: Representation-focused companion to ESM3, released as open weights
Reported to perform similarly to ESM-2 650M with less memory and faster inference
when_to_use: A cost-efficient modern encoder: good when you want ESM-2-650M-level quality at smaller size / 960-dim embeddings.
caveats: Documented in a release note rather than a peer-reviewed paper.

citations.title: ESM Cambrian: Revealing the mysteries of proteins with unsupervised learning
